title: Legacy lane B batch 34: Local Uprising and Main Power Generators

cards.title: Local Uprising / Liberation (V)
issues: Liberation clause 'Wedge may not cancel battle destiny draws on Hoth' not implemented (MayNotCancelBattleDestinyModifier is not source-scoped).

cards.title: Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V)
issues: LS clause 'Unique speeders cannot be thrown' not implemented.

review.blocked_on: (1) Modifier preventing a specific card (Wedge) from canceling battle destiny at a location; (2) engine support for preventing a speeder being 'thrown'. Both are worker requests in swccg-guild/work#182; no prerequisite PR in the review set.
review.fix_instructions: Add the two missing clauses with tests once support exists.
review.notes: Rest of both cards is solid: startup (Hoth, VB6 MPG, optional Echo Base Garrison / Maneuvering Flaps, deploy restrictions, T-47 Battle Formation once per game + Sense immunity), deploy-phase download, flip conditions, blown-away out of play, Liberation Force loss / take card / loss reduction; MPG shield coverage, 8 Force blow-away, powered artillery. 23 tests.

pc_front.gametext: Local Uprising: Deploy Hoth system and [Virtual Block 6] Main Power Generators. May deploy Echo Base Garrison and/or Maneuvering Flaps. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy Hoth Sentry or non-Hoth locations (except Rendezvous Point). T-47 Battle Formation may only be played once per game and is [Immune to Sense]. {While} this side up, during your deploy phase, may deploy an exterior Hoth site or a non-unique Rebel to Hoth from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card during your move phase if you control 3 exterior Hoth sites with T-47s and/or non-unique Rebels. {Place} out of play if Main Power Generators 'blown away'. Liberation: {While} this side up, Wedge may not cancel battle destiny draws on Hoth. During your control phase: opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground marker site you control with both a T-47 and a Rebel, and you may use 2 Force to take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Whenever you must lose Force (except from your card, battle damage, or a Force drain at a battleground), reduce the loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of Hoth locations you occupy. {Flip} this card if you do not control 2 exterior Hoth sites. {Place} out of play if if Main Power Generators 'blown away'.
pc_front.title: Local Uprising / Liberation (V)

pc_front.gametext: Light: While Liberation on table, Hoth Energy Shield covers only this site and Echo sites. Unique (•) speeders cannot be 'thrown.' Dark: 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' in effect. If 'blown away,' Light Side loses 8 Force. Artillery weapons on Hoth are powered.
pc_front.title: •Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V)
